tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam sras dzam la nor rgyun gsum 'khor dang bcas pa mchod tshul dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam sras dzam la nor rgyun gsum 'khor dang bcas pa mchod tshul dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam sras dzam la nor rgyun gsum 'khor dang

bcas pa mchod tshul dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs bsags smin pa'i 'bras/ /yo byad 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod chen la/ /dbang bsgyur nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi/ /zhabs la btud nas de dag sgrub tshul bshad/ /'dir nor lha'i rgyal po rnam thos sras 'khor bcas dang*/ dzam bha la dang nor rgyun ma 'khor bcas la mchod tshul gsum gyi dang po la rgyas bsdus mang yang 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas na/ pho brang rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang bcas pa'i sku'am/ yang na shog ras sogs la gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang*/ de'i nang ngos su rim pa gnyis byas pa'i nang ma'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris te mdun du stegs kyi steng du bkram pa la dbus dang phyogs mtshams su sku med na tshom bu bkod de/ gtor ma zlum po dgu ril bu dang bcas pa la mar dkar gyis byug pa dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ grub na 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs dang*/ rin po che'i rigs bshams rgyu byung na 'byor ba 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod/ bdag bskyed la 'jigs byed dang*/ rta mgrin lta bu gang yang rung mod/ 'dir phyag rdor la brten na ni de la'ang rgyas bsdus gnyis las phyi ma'i dbang du byas na skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan cing dbu skra khams ser gyen du brjes shing*/ sprul dang rin po ches brgyad pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ rgyas par na ye shes pa dgug bstim mchod bstod dang snying po bzlas pa rnams bya'o/

/mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ auṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ auṃ āḥhūṃ/ auṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ dang*/ spar sha āḥhūṃ gi bar dang*/ auṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a wa rta ya a wa rta ya ho badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pa lan gsum brjod cing byin brlabs bya'o/ /de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i nang ma la khang brtsegs rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ logs rnams su dra ba dang dra phyed 'phyang zhing mda' yab dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bai las rgyal mtshan bai las mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus nas bai la thim/ rgyal mtshan bai yig dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ g.yon ne'u le rin po che skyug pa 'dzin cing*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ sed+ge nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng du zhabs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ de'i shar du pad zla'i gdan la dzam bha la ser po g.yas rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po g.yas bum pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po g.yas nor bu/ byang du ku be ra nag po g.yas ral gri/

shar lhor yang dag shes ser po g.yas gser gri /lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po g.yas rin po che'i mdung*/ nub byang du lngas rtsen ser skya g.yas khang brtsegs/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil ba dkar po g.yas gri phub bsnams shing*/ g.yon thams cad gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ rang mdog dang mthun pa'i rta la chibs shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid pa'i gzugs can/ rim pa gnyis pa la gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyang g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang g.yon thams cad ne'u le 'dzin pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bum bzang brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ ljon shing brgyad/ rdzing bu brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad la sogs pa spel mar gnas pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi spyi bor auṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā:dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros te byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras rta bdag brgyad nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ /༈ bai ri rab lhun bo'i byang phyogs kyi/ /lcang lo can nas nor gyi bdag /rnam mang thos sras 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan drangs thogs med gshegs su gsol/ /auṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ auṃ bai swāhā/ bai zhes lan 'ga' brjod/ auṃ rat+na mu gu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod de rin po che'i dbu rgyan phul/ /dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /bsang gtor la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /auṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra brok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tits+tsha āḥhūṃ/ sngags de bzhin du sbyar te/ ar+gha/ pād+yaṃ/ añtsa mā ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/

shap+ta'i bar dang*/ /me long pi wang dung chos dang*/ /ro mchog 'jam mnyen gos dag kyang*/ /rgyal chen= /bzhes nas=/ oṃ =pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ gdugs nya pad+ma bum bzang dung*/ /dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo rnams/ /rgyan chen=/ bzhes nas=/ oṃ bai =aṣ+ta mad+ga laṃ pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo rta/ /blon po glang po dmag dpon rnams/ /rgyal chen= /bzhes nas=/ auṃ bai = ma hā sap+ta rat+na pra tits+tsha āḥhūṃ/ zhes phul te/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang lnga ni/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bu brjid chags shing*/ /sprin bral nyi ma stong gi gzi ldan pa/ /'dod rgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag med bsod nams tshogs chen rab bsags mthus/ /yo byad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa kun sel dngos grub mchog /stsol mdzad nor lha'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad 'bul/ /sgo gsum nyes ltung thams cad so sor bshags/ /rang gzhan kun gyi dge la rjes yi rang*/ /'gro la phan sgrub 'dod rgu stsol ba'i phyir/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs/ /dge kun mchog thun dngos grub thob phyir bsngo/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog mod gal te bskang gso mtshon tsam byed na/ sngar ltar mchod pa dang bskang rdzas rnams rgyas par na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ hūṃ sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /mchod rdzas sa dang bar snang khyon bkang ste/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bdag cag re ltos mchod la dngos grub stsol/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis/ /rgyal chen=/ bdag cag=/ gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab lhun po dang*/

/dri sman 'bru sna rin chen sna tshogs kyis/ /rgyal chen= /bdag cag= /gos sngon lung thang phreng ba cang shes rta/ /gter bum dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i bas/ /rgyal chen= /bdag cag= /khrus rdzing khang brtsegs gtor ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bris sku dam pa yis/ /rgyal chen=/ bdag= /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod tshogs 'di bzhes nas/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /de nas/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra zhes sogs kyi gzungs ring bzla ba'am/ min yang rung ste/ auṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ auṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya swāhā/ auṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ auṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ auṃ ku be ra ya swāhā/ auṃ sam+ba dza na ye swāhā/ auṃ gu h+ya ta na ye swāhā/ auṃ bañtsi ka ye swāhā/ auṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li swāhā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/ de nas gtor ma bsangs/ sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ auṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ auṃ bai shra waṇa ye i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun dang*/ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra/ zhes pa nas pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li i dam zhes sogs sbyar nas so sor 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na/ auṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i dam/ zhes sogs sbyar te thun mong du phul yang rung ngo*/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtong ma 'di bzhes su gsol bzhes nas bdag cag gi mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang 'dod don dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/

de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ dpag med dus nas tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shing*/ /dri bral zhi ba'i go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang po'i skur bstan pa/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos pa'i sras la bstod/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi ye shes mchog thob nas/ /srid gsum 'gro rnams phongs dang rgud pa las/ /skyob mdzad 'dod rgu'i dngos grub mchog ster ba/ /'gro ba'i mgon gyur khyod la gus pas bstod/ /sngon tshe ston pa'i drung du bstan pa dang*/ /'jig rten khams kun chos bzhin skyong ba ru/ /zhal bzhes de don sgrub la rtag gzhol ba/ /bstan srung kun gyi gtso bor gyur la bstod/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon mthu ldan thams cad kyang*/ /khyod zhabs bsten nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa yis/ /'gro 'di'i phongs pa kun zhi 'dod rgu'i dngos/ /ster mdzad gnod sbyin rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan ar+ya dzam la sogs/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po mched brgyad kyang*/ rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng bzhugs 'gro rnams kyi/ /phongs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad la bstod/ /nor lha gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ /rang rang phyag g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ /g.yon na rin chen skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin/ /'dod rgu'i re ba skong bar mdzad la bstod/ /khyod rnams mchod cing bstod dang bskul ba'i mthus/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /rgyas par na/ rin chen dam pa'i pho brang nas/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dzam bha la ni gser gyi mdog /zhes sogs kyis bstod kyang legs/ mjug tu slar mchod bstod mdor bsdus 'dod na bya zhing*/ yig brgya brjod de/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bzod gsol dang*/ sku rten yod na/

'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis brtan bzhugs bya zhing*/ rten med na/ badz+ra muḥ nor lha 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur zhes brjod cing shis brjod bya'o// //༈ gnyis pa dzam+bha la gtso 'khor mchod tshul ni/ ras shog la gru bzhi sgo bzhi byas pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa bris te stegs kyi khar bkram la/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams su sku'am tshom bu dgod cing brgyan/ mthar zlum gtor dgu chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ grub na 'dod yon/ rgyal srid/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rin po che sogs gang 'byor bshams nas skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang ste/ bdag bskyed la 'jigs byed sogs gzhan gyis rung yang*/ phyag rdor byed pa la gos sngon can dang gtum po lta bu gang yin pa de'i mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun chog kyang*/ 'dir rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ auṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ auṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥ hūṃ nas shap+ta dang*/ rū pa nas spar sha āḥhūṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas te/ auṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra nas ho badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ sgrub gzhi a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ pha gu dra ba dang dra phyed/ mda' yab sogs kyis mdzes par byas pa'i khang brtsegs nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re/

dbus su pad zla'i gdan la dzaṃ ser po/ de yongs su gyur pa las dzam bha la sku mdog ser po/ phyag g.yas bi dza pū ra ka dang g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ 'od kyi dra bas mdzes pa'o/ /de'i shar du nor bu bzang po/ lhor gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor spyin/ byang du rnam thos sras/ shar lhor ki li mī li/ lho nub tu pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ nub byang du gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du tsa ren+d+ra ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas bi dza pū ra ka dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i g.yon du lha mo nor rgyun ma/ gzhan brgyad kyi g.yon phyogs su rim pa bzhin du/ chu shel ma/ so ma/ so legs ma/ 'phags ma/ shin tu bzang mo/ sbas ma/ rab sbas ma/ dbyangs can ma ste/ thams cad kyang g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pas yab kyi dku la brten cing*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi smad g.yogs gsol ba/ phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi spyi bor auṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros lcang lo can sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ auṃ ār+ya dzam bha la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza dza/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ haṃḥ/ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas sbyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bas/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur lus gang*/

dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las thams cad la rin 'byung gis dbu rgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ rab 'byams zhing na gang mchis pa'i/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dzam la 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /auṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te pād+yaṃ nas shap+ta dang rū pa nas/ spar+sha pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar dang*/ rab 'byams zhing na gang mchis pa'i/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun rnams/ /dzam la= /bzhes nas= /tsakra rat+na dang ma ṇi rat+na/ s+t+ri rat+na/ pu ru ṣa rat+na/ ha sti rat+na/ a shwa rat+na/ khat+ga rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā dang*/ rab 'byams zhing na gang mchis pa'i/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad thams cad kyang*/ dzam la= /bzhes nas= /aṣ+ta mad+ga laṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas/ /dzam la= /bzhes nas= /auṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pū dza me gha pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sby-in nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /'phags pa dzam la 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de nas snying po bzla ba ni/ auṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ auṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ dha na da ye swāhā/ auṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye swāhā/ auṃ ki li mī li ni ye swāhā/ auṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swāhā/ auṃ mu khen+d+ra ye swāhā/ auṃ tsa ren+d+ra ye swāhā/ yang*/ auṃ ba su dhā ri ni swāhā/ auṃ tsan+d+ra kān+t+yai ye swāhā/ auṃ dan+tā ye swāhā/ auṃ su dan+tā ye swāhā/ auṃ ār+ya ye swāhā/ auṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ gup+ta ye swāhā/ auṃ de bai ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/

gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ auṃ ā:hūṃ lan gsum/ ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ auṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis phul te/ auṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ khyed rnams kyis mchod sby-in gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol lo/ /bstod pa ni/ rgya chen bsod nams tshogs bsags smin pa'i 'bras/ /yo byad nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ khams gsum 'gro la 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol ba/ / 'phags pa dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang sku rin chen gser gyi lhun po bzhin/ /rnam mang rin chen rgyu skar do shal can/ /zhal nas rin chen char 'bebs 'gro rnams kyi/ /phongs pa'i sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nges don rdzogs sangs go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang*/ /'gro ba'i don du gnod sby-in dbang po'i skur/ /mngon bstan 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen mdzod 'chang zhing*/ /'dzad med gter gyi dpal la longs spyod pa/ /'gro la 'dod rgu'i dngos ster nor gyi lha/ /'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod rnams mchod cing gsol 'debs 'di dgongs la/ /bdag cag phongs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ /gser dngul rin chen rta phyugs 'bru dar sogs/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe ring nad med dbang thang dar ba dang*/ /rtag tu bde legs phun sum tshogs pa kun/

/'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /de nas yig brgya tshar gcig brjod de/ rten yod na/ khyed rnams mchod pa'i skabs 'dir bdag cag gis/ ma 'byor nyams sogs nyes kun bzod bzhes te/ /rang gi rten dang dbyer med rtag bzhugs nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /auṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod de me tog gtor la bsngo smon sogs bya zhing*/ rten med na ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mjug tu/ auṃ badz+ra muḥmagron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces dang*/ shis brjod bya'o//༈ gsum pa nor rgyun ma 'khor bcas mchod tshul ni/ gong du dzam la'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin dkyil 'khor bris pa stegs kyi khar bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor rnams sngar ltar bshams la/ skyabs sems sogs dang bdag bskyed dang mchod pa byin brlab kyang de bzhin byas te/ mdun gyi sgrub gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bh+ruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ zhes pa nas/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi pad zla'i gdan la paṃ yig ser po/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo nor rgyun ma/ shar du bzang mo/ lhor rab tu bzang mo/ nub tu sbas ma/ byang du rab sbas ma/ shar lhor lha mo/ lho nub tu dbyangs can ma/ nub byang du 'phags ma/ byang shar du zla shel can te/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog ser mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing*/ bud med sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur can/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nor rgyun ma'i bha ga'i nang du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar dzaṃ las dzam la ser po/ g.yas bi dza pū ra ka dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan cing*/

zhal nas rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa nor rgyun ma ser mo la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems phyir 'phros pa'i rin po che'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur te sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnod sby-in chen po bcu drug du gyur pa ni/ shar du gang ba bzang po dmar po/ lhor rnam thos sras ser po/ nub tu nor sbyin dmar po/ byang du nor bu bzang po ser po/ shar lhor bi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li dmar po/ lho nub tu rol pa'i phreng ba sngon po/ nub byang du spyod pa'i dbang po ser po/ byang shar du sgo'i dbang po ser po ste/ thams cad kyang g.yas bi dza pū ra ka dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po/ lho sgor pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po/ nub sgor ki li mī li dang ki li mī li chen po/ byang sgor gang ba dang gang ba bzang po ste/ de thams cad kyang gcer bu lto ba dang 'bras bu 'phyang ba rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi spyi bor auṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nor lha'i pho brang nas lha mo nor rgyun ma dzam la nor lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza dza/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ auṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/

dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rin 'byung gtso bor byas pa'i rigs lngas dbu rgyan par gyur par bsam/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo sogs/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /nor rgyun lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /'bul bgyi bzhes nas dngos grub stsol/ /auṃ ba su dha ri ni dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ auṃ ba su dha ri ni= /pād+yaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta'i bar dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid bdun/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad thams cad kyang*/ /nor rgyun= /'bul bgyi= /auṃ ba su = pañtsa ka ma gu na ma hā sap+ta rat+na aṣ+ta mad+ga laṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye shri ye hūṃ/ gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab lhun/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas/ /nor rgyun= /'bul bgyi= /auṃ ba su dha ri ṇi= ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas mchod de/ gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog ster ba/ /nor rgyun lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de nas snying po bzla ba ni/ auṃ ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ auṃ bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ gup+ta ye swāhā/ auṃ su gup+ta ye swāhā/ auṃ de bai ye swāhā/ auṃ swa ra swa t+yai ye swāhā/ auṃ ar+ya ye swāhā/ auṃ tsan+d+ra kān+t+yai ye swāhā/ zhes dang*/ yang*/ auṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ auṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye swāhā/ auṃ dha na da ye swāhā/ auṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ auṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swāhā/ auṃ ki li mī li ni ye swāhā/ auṃ tsa ren+d+ra ye swāhā/ auṃ mu khen+d+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/ de nas gtor ma ni/ sngags kyis bsangs sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

auṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ auṃ ba su dha ri ni dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis phul te/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig bzhes nas kyang rnal 'byor ba bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ bstod pa ni/ gser mdog blta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku/ /rab snyan rgyud mang 'bum phrag sgrogs pa'i gsung*/ /rnam mang 'gro la rjes su brtse ba'i thugs/ / rgyal ba'i yum gyur nor rgyun ma la bstod/ /zag bcas dngos la chags bral 'dzin med kyang*/ /ma dag 'gro la brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /phun tshogs nam mkha'i mdzod kun rtag 'chang zhing*/ /stsol mdzad nor gyi dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /khyod thugs 'dod pa'i dri mas ma gos kyang*/ /'jig rten rjes mthun lha mo'i skur bstan te/ /'phags mchog rmugs 'dzin dbang dang sbyor mdzad pa/ /rgyal yum lha mo khyod la gus pas bstod/ /snyigs dus sdug cing phongs pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'dod rgu'i dngos grub mchog /ster mdzad ār+ya dzam+bha la la sogs/ /nor lha 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed rnams mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /gnas skabs su yang yul phyogs 'di dag tu/ /'thab rtsod mu ge nad yams kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod rgyas pa sogs/ /bkra shis dpal gyis phyogs kun khyab par shog /de nas yig brgya brjod de/ ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs bzhis bzod gsol byas nas/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/

zhes sogs rkang ba bzhis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ auṃ badz+ra muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gshegs gsol dang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod ci ltar rigs pa bya'o/ /dad ldan dag gis bskul ba'i ngor/ / don gnyer gzhan la'ang phan pa'i ched/ /nor lha chen po yongs grags kyi/ / mchod tshul 'jug pa bde bar bkod/ /de las thob pa'i rnam dkar dges/ / phongs pa'i sdug bsngal las grol te/ /dus kun bde 'byor dpal rnyed cing*/ / nam mkha' mdzod la longs spyod shog /ces pa 'di ni mdo'i dad ldan rgya mtsho skyabs kyis 'di lta bu zhig gyis na bdag gis bar du brko bar bya'o zhes bskul ba brten nas shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis dam pa snga ma'i gsung rgyun la brten nas bgyis pa ste/ nor lha 'di dag la tshul bzhin mchod na tshe 'dir ma zad/ skye ba phyi ma rnams su 'byor ldan du 'gyur bar bshad pas don che bar nges so/ /bar gyi yi ge pa ni tho lo'i sngags 'chang rnam dpyod can tshe dbang mgon po'o// //mad+ga laṃ/ /

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal chen rnam sras dzam la nor rgyun gsum 'khor dang bcas pa mchod tshul dngos grub dpal ster bzhugs/ -PAGE 106--PAGE 105--PAGE 90-
